content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Project Research Scientist-1 (Non-Medical) Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Research Scientist-1 (Non-Medical) post at AIIMS Jodhpur is scheduled for 24 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Research Scientist-1 (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required is a Post Graduate Degree, including integrated PG degrees. Desirable qualifications include experience in community-based projects and proficiency in statistical software.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Research Scientist-1 (Non-Medical) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist-1 (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 56,000/- per month, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as admissible.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the AIIMS Jodhpur Project Research Scientist-1 (Non-Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a walk-in recruitment. Interested and eligible candidates need to attend the walk-in interview at the specified venue and time with all required original documents and photocopies.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the AIIMS Jodhpur Project Research Scientist-1 (Non-Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST). Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of these documents, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable). Recent passport-size photographs are also required.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Jodhpur, Rajasthan, 342005. The exact reporting time and venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The position of Project Research Scientist-1 (Non-Medical) is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve a Walk-in Interview. A Screening/Scrutiny Test may be conducted if deemed necessary by the authorities.
